title: This Mammal's Heart Beats 1,500 Times a Minute

scenes.text: The smallest mammal's heart beats fifteen hundred times a minute.
The Etruscan shrew is only the size of a one euro coin.
To keep going it must eat up to twice its own weight in food every day.
Go without food for just four hours and it can starve to death.
Its body burns so hot it can never rest.
Fifteen hundred beats. Every minute. Forever.

description:
The Etruscan shrew weighs about 1.8 grams and its heart can beat up to 1,511 times a minute.
It eats one and a half to two times its own weight each day and can starve if it goes without food for about four hours.
Could you eat that much?
first_comment: A human heart beats about seventy times a minute. What tiny animal amazes you?
